note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_exam_simulator.py; type=manual require agent/render/research inspection.

GATE_1_configuration.text: OV-EXSIM routing signals confirmed and recorded; Children's Category Research completed and stored
Exam Format Evidence record exists with live sources dated to this engagement (Research Before Generation gate)
Title Clearance record with sources and date; non-affiliation statement drafted for Copyright page naming the exam owner
Subtitle states the exact total with 'Practice Questions', letters/numerals/spaces only, fits two lines
Byline fetched live from FNG, collision-checked, locked; Title Design Signature cleared the distinctness gate
Set count and questions per set derived from operator-supplied total; sets mapped to domains with blueprint-proportional weighting; seed recorded
Content-fixed correct-answer patterns authored at blueprint time; exhibit positions declared and justified (default zero); Domain Master reviewed blueprint coverage

GATE_2_per_set.text: Every stem is a complete self-contained question; no double negatives; no trick constructions
Distractors plausible, mutually exclusive, parallel in grammar and length to the key; no absurd throwaway options
Domain Master confirmation recorded for every item: exactly one single defensible correct answer
No 'all of the above', 'none of the above', or option-letter references in stems or options (or pinning status recorded)
Every rationale addresses every distractor; 50 words or fewer; content-based (no letter references)
Two equal columns, separator rule on, set subhead full-width; full-width break for scenario/exhibit items
Question numbers and option letters are typed text; no Word auto-numbering; numbering continuous from prior set with no gaps or duplicates
Answer Pattern Audit on the built file: distribution within tolerance, max run within effective cap, no doubled 4-permutation, no tripled 2-alternation
Compliance sweep PASS (em/en dashes absent, curly apostrophes, no AI voice); Content Standards PASS; Amazon Content Policy scan PASS
Set pages rasterized and inspected; column balance, folio, margin alignment verified

GATE_3_randomization.text: Engine run on the complete bank from the recorded seed; per-set report delivered (before/after distributions and runs, moves, pins, flags, effective cap)
Text at each new key equals text at original key; option multisets match for every item
Balanced key distribution per set within one of even (quota tolerance)
Any two-option in-sequence type carries a run cap of at least 2 (shipped default 3); auto-raise logged
ANSWERS AND EXPLANATIONS generated from the randomized mapping; Practice Exam N subheads mirror the question division one to one; both divisions two-column
Every answer entry number matches its question number across the full bank
Score Interpretation Guide: no pass-probability claims; performance bands descriptive; study strategies reference appendices and sourced resources only

GATE_4_release.text: Score Interpretation Guide measures 1.40 to 1.55 pages on the render; corrections via substantive content only
How to Use This Book measures 1.40 to 1.55 pages on the render
Appendix A Exam Blueprint Summary sourced from the Exam Format Evidence record; disclaimed as subject to change; no invented statistics
Appendix B Time-Per-Question Budget calculation shown (researched time limit / item count); pacing strategies practical
Two-pass Contents gate: printed folios equal actual for every entry; no 'undefined' strings; live folio fields; front matter folio-free
Every IMAGE PROMPT block removed; opening and closing table tags balance; marker string absent
Contrast >=4.5:1 for every pair; byline appears exactly twice (title page, copyright), name only; non-affiliation statement present on copyright page
No invented statistics/regulations/thresholds/attributions anywhere including marketing; Operator Zero Correction Standard met; release record written
